name: Phu Long clam
summary: Ngao Phù Long is the clam on the island’s special-zone list, named for Phù Long on the northwest shore. The plain ngao, ngao vàng, and ngao trắng on the harbor boards carry no Phù Long label.
howToEat: Ask for it by its full name, since an unlabeled ngao is a different order.
where: Phù Long, on the northwest shore of the island.
seoTitle: Ngao Phù Long — the Cat Ba clam
